_doc: How the Warlock's hair chains swing (pipeline/unreal/820: one AnimDynamics node per chain in the mesh's post-process AnimBP). Unreal component space (Blender x, -y, z), cm, degrees. spheres: bodies kept outside them (chains: only those chains; a sphere that would hold a body of the rest pose is shrunk to clear it by margin_cm). overrides: per chain, by name prefix.
_space: Component: the bodies move with her and feel a share of her acceleration (component_acc_scale: starting, stopping, landing), of her velocity (component_vel_scale: trailing as she runs) and of her turning (angular_alpha); in World space they were left behind as she ran and the chains stretched

planes._what: her back: a plane under the back hair, its normal out of her back (Unreal -Y); placed as close under the hair as its rest pose allows

_planes: spheres pushed each back strand out a different way and tore them apart (38 cm); a plane pushes them all alike
_solver: iterations before / after the bodies move: 4 / 1 let the joints come apart by 60 % and more under her running and landing; 48 / 16 keeps it to about 35 % at the moment of a jump (2 to 3 cm on these 6 to 7 cm bones), 5 % when she stands. More (48 / 48) changed nothing, nor did the spring, the limits or clamping the acceleration
